readerContract.humanQuestion: What would each LAiDIES publication actually sound like, and are the formats meaningfully different rather than nine labels for the same AI-written article?
readerContract.promisedPayoff: Ali can compare one concrete example of every planned NewsStand and service-column format, reject weak directions and refine the templates before a production backlog is generated.
readerContract.priorKnowledge: The reader knows LAiDIES should be useful, accurate, fun and grounded in the Rewind Era, but does not need to know the internal publication schemas or production workflow.
readerContract.centralMentalModel: A verified signal can serve more than one publication, but each version must perform a different reader job: interrupt, report, synthesize, argue, answer, troubleshoot or supply one small practical move.
readerContract.dailyLifeConnection: The sampler connects current-looking AI headlines, ordinary AI frustrations, workplace delegation and prompting habits to choices a non-technical professional woman can make.
readerContract.surfaceJob: A private editorial comparison artifact containing one deliberately bounded example for each of nine formats. It is not a live issue, an archive entry, a release candidate or permission to publish stale source material.
readerContract.desiredFeeling: I can finally see what belongs where, why I would read each format and which voices or structures are worth keeping.

canonicalTruth.freshnessTrigger: Any change to a publication job, cadence, destination, naming decision or multi-output rule.
Any proposal to treat the July incident examples as current or publishable; any new technical report, chronology or correction.
Any correction to the held July 29 draft or proposal to reuse its factual prose.
Any source or editorial disposition change to the July incident Weekly.
Any source, thesis or counterargument change to the held open-versus-closed security argument.
Any status, source, expiry, wording or eligibility change to the bound service-column records.
Any change to DMJ-001, its future canonical answer or the Dear Miss Jeeves format contract.
Any successor admission for Vocab 101 or change to the generation, context, grounding or hallucination definitions used as provisional source material.
Any change to Episode 2's context, constraint or verification lesson.
Any change to the delegation seed, its AI mirror or safety boundary.

strengthsToUse: State the dated change and its scope before interpretation.
Finish with a specific reader action that the evidence earns.
patternsNotToCopy: Do not treat one legal-news structure as the template for all nine formats.
Do not inherit dated claims or local editorial status as current public truth.
Do not reuse the exemplar's analogy when a shorter direct explanation does the job.

glossaryAccumulation.producerGuard: Every sample must perform its publication job instead of collecting AI vocabulary.
glossaryAccumulation.preventionEvidence: The nine-section architecture is organized by reader outcome, not terms.

templateRepetition.producerGuard: No shared heading sequence may be copied across all formats.
templateRepetition.preventionEvidence: Each format has a distinct length, opening, evidence density and landing.

decorativeAnalogy.producerGuard: An analogy appears only if it shortens a mechanism and states its limit.
decorativeAnalogy.preventionEvidence: The plan authorizes no compulsory analogy or Rewind reference.

referenceConfetti.producerGuard: Rewind Era voice must come through cadence and earned wit, not dropped names.
referenceConfetti.preventionEvidence: No quota for cultural references exists in the architecture.

missingMechanism.producerGuard: Explanatory samples trace the relevant cause-and-effect chain rather than naming a phenomenon.
missingMechanism.preventionEvidence: The causal sequence binds signal verification, format job, reader consequence and bounded action.

genericAction.producerGuard: Every action names the exact source, setting, check or boundary the reader should use.
genericAction.preventionEvidence: The useful action is a format-specific test, not 'be careful with AI'.

jargonBeforeMeaning.producerGuard: Plain reader stakes precede specialist terms, which appear only when they improve precision.
jargonBeforeMeaning.preventionEvidence: Each sample begins with the change, question, frustration or workplace situation.

disconnectedSystem.producerGuard: Every example connects its event or tip to the relevant AI mechanism and destination.
disconnectedSystem.preventionEvidence: The sampler explicitly shows how one signal can feed distinct outputs without copy-paste reuse.

joylessInstruction.producerGuard: Use warm adult language and earned wit while retaining uncertainty and mechanism.
joylessInstruction.preventionEvidence: Service columns carry voice; factual formats remain readable without becoming flippant.

purposeTooNarrow.producerGuard: The sampler tests the complete publication system, not a single incident or workplace use case.
purposeTooNarrow.preventionEvidence: Nine formats cover news, analysis, reference, troubleshooting and daily service.

mechanismBeforeMotivation.producerGuard: Each format establishes why the reader cares before explaining how the system behaves.
mechanismBeforeMotivation.preventionEvidence: The section plan starts with consequence, question or recognisable problem.

workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.producerGuard: The July incident illustrates format differences but cannot define the whole NewsStand.
workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.preventionEvidence: Straight Answers, Miss Jeeves and service columns use separate situations and mechanisms.

technicalExplainerVoice.producerGuard: Write for a smart non-technical woman, not for an auditor or system designer.
technicalExplainerVoice.preventionEvidence: Internal status notes stay outside the example prose; reader-facing copy uses direct language.

draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: The same verified development can be urgent news today, part of a weekly pattern later and evidence in a deeper argument—but only if each piece gives the reader a different useful result.
causalSequence: A signal is checked against exact original and primary sources and assigned a dated evidence boundary.
The signal is routed only to formats whose reader job it genuinely serves.
Each format selects a different question, evidence scope and consequence instead of repackaging identical prose.
The reader receives either a timely change, a pattern, an argument, a direct answer, a diagnosis or one testable action.
Freshness, uncertainty and correction triggers stay attached to every resulting artifact.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: The held July OpenAI/Hugging Face incident becomes an archive-format Breaking update, one strand of a Weekly synthesis and evidence inside a Big Question about whether access labels establish security.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: A future workplace AI product announcement might earn a Daily report, update an existing Straight Answer and inspire a Career tip only if each contribution has a different source-bound reader payoff.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Compare each sample by asking: why would I read this format, what do I know afterward, what can I do, and could its text be swapped with another section without anyone noticing? If it could, the format has failed.

humourPlan.lessonJob: Use light Rewind-era newspaper and advice-column cadence to distinguish service voices and make one behaviour memorable; do not joke over incident impact or factual uncertainty.

draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: One internal preface followed by nine independent samples: archive Breaking; dated Daily front page; Weekly synthesis; The Big Question argument; Straight Answers reference; Dear Miss Jeeves advice; Paige practical AI tip; Career/Work-Life tip with an earned AI mirror; and Promptoscope. Each section carries its evidence/freshness status and a one-line format test.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: The artifact is a comparison set, not a universal article template. Breaking leads with the changed fact; Daily curates a complete paper; Weekly connects developments; Big Question argues with a counterargument; Straight Answers answers first; Miss Jeeves diagnoses; the three service columns land one small action in distinct voices.

communicationDesign.surfaceAdaptation: Use direct-answer openings for news, reference and advice; retain concrete mechanisms and precise landings only where the format has explanatory work. Do not force a lecture arc into short service columns.

humanQuestion.reason: Every format needs a distinct reason for the reader to care.
humanQuestion.plannedEvidence: Each sample opens with its event, recurring question, frustration or workplace decision.

usefulCuriosity.reason: The Big Question, Miss Jeeves and Promptoscope need a tension whose resolution reveals something useful.
usefulCuriosity.plannedEvidence: Their hooks resolve into an explicit mechanism and action rather than lingering as wordplay.

invisibleProcessConcrete.reason: Security controls, context limits and generative verification are otherwise easy to collapse into vague AI behaviour.
invisibleProcessConcrete.plannedEvidence: The explanatory samples name the exact information, access or checking step that changes the result.

familiarTechnicalMovement.reason: Non-technical readers need to move from a recognisable situation into the correct distinction and back to a decision.
familiarTechnicalMovement.plannedEvidence: Miss Jeeves and service columns connect ordinary use to context, constraints or verification, then return to a specific move.

limitationsConsequences.reason: News and advice become misleading when uncertainty, expiry or product boundaries disappear.
limitationsConsequences.plannedEvidence: Archive status, unknowns, analogy limits, source expiry and product-versus-user boundaries appear where relevant.

humourSurprise.reason: The service-column identities benefit from one earned memorable line, while serious news does not.
humourSurprise.plannedEvidence: Miss Jeeves, Paige and Promptoscope may use a short joke only after the practical distinction is clear.

betterNextQuestion.reason: Every format should leave a reader with a more precise check or choice.
betterNextQuestion.plannedEvidence: Each example ends with an exact action, watch point or decision question.

explanationArc.adaptation: Breaking and Straight Answers answer first; Weekly and Big Question spend more space on mechanism and evidence; advice and service columns compress the arc into situation, distinction and one move.

representativeProofPlan.highestRisk: Nine polished samples could still be one generic AI voice wearing different mastheads, while stale held research quietly reads as current publication.
representativeProofPlan.plannedProof: Produce one compact, clearly status-labelled sampler in which every section has a distinct reader job and the reused July incident changes question and evidence scope across formats. Run exact-prose producer self-review before Ali sees it; do not integrate or publish any sample.
representativeProofPlan.acceptanceOutcome: Ali can explain the difference between all nine formats from the examples alone, identify which voices and structures to keep, and review no false claim that the archive or expired material is current or release-ready.
